placements.title: System Reliability and Recovery Verification
placements.frame: How does the organization establish, test, and verify operational resilience and recovery mechanisms?

placements.title: Operational Capability Exists Only Through Continuous Rehearsal
placements.frame: How does routine practical rehearsal transform theoretical recovery procedures into validated operational capabilities?
placements.why: Frames the foundational technical and operational principle that rollback mechanisms must be routinely rehearsed on a committed cadence to be considered real capabilities.
